title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide & Design Details
description: Sony and Rockstar have teamed up for GTA 6 limited-edition PS5 controllers in black and white. Check out the pre-order guide for US and UK, plus design details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide & Design Details

As the highly anticipated launch of *Grand Theft Auto VI* approaches, Sony and Rockstar Games have officially teamed up to offer fans a special hardware treat. A pair of limited-edition PS5 controllers themed around GTA 6 have been announced, giving players a stylish way to dive into the next era of open-world gaming.

According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, pre-order links are now live for players in the USA and UK. Both controllers are scheduled to launch on November 19th, 2026—the exact same day the game hits shelves.

### Black and White Variants with Unique Design Elements

The limited-edition lineup features two distinct colorways: a sleek black version and a classic white version. Both models incorporate aesthetic details that capture the atmosphere of the game:

* **Striking Faceplate Accent**: Both the black and white controllers sport a vibrant blue and purple faceplate surrounding the thumbsticks and touchpad.
* **Official Branding**: The iconic GTA 6 logo is prominently printed directly onto the touchpad.
* **Thematic Textures**: The two handles feature subtle palm tree indentations, offering a nod to the sun-soaked, tropical aesthetic of the game's setting.

### Release Date and Availability

For collectors and fans eager to secure their hardware ahead of time, here are the essential details:

* **Release Date**: November 19th, 2026
* **Regions**: USA and UK links are currently available for pre-order.
* **Where to Buy**: Players can access pre-order channels via official retail links provided by gaming coverage sources like Push Square.

Given the monumental status of Rockstar's upcoming title, limited-edition accessories like these are expected to be in high demand. Fans looking to complete their setup by November should lock in their pre-orders early.

## Editor's Take

This official collaboration between Sony and Rockstar delivers a neat collector's item for hardcore fans. The subtle palm tree textures and blue/purple accents give it a distinct Vice City vibe without being overly flashy. If you are upgrading your setup for November 19, 2026, securing one of these pre-orders early is definitely recommended.
